headline: City council pay, staggered terms, and term limits drew discussion in the city charter review.
summary: Council pay is $100 a month, and several members asked that pay be moved out of the charter and into the budget process. Staggered terms, three-year terms, and term limits drew the most comments from members and residents. The next meeting is set for next Monday, when the mayor's role and the budget committee are expected to be discussed.
discussion: Council pay: Several members said the $100 a month pay is too low and asked that pay be set through the budget process instead of the charter.
Staggered and three-year terms: Speakers debated longer terms and staggered elections. Some said staggering keeps experience on the council, and others said it limits voter changes.
Term limits: Speakers were split. Some opposed term limits, and others said long-serving councilors should take a break.
Vacancies and absences: One proposal would fill a council vacancy by election at the next election cycle. Another would count three unexcused absences in a row as a vacancy.
Public engagement: Residents asked for ward meetings and a public engagement section in the charter. Participatory budgeting was also raised.
